# build/agent3/toypad/routes/level-l.txt - Agent 3, run-2 task 2: the S4b queue's L route (title -> menu walk -> one
# level load). Generated by gen_route_l.py. Needs the toypad sidecar (queue row "toypad":true: it places the virtual
# Batman/Gandalf/Wyldstyle tags 2 s after the C8 all-pads-white line). FUNCTIONAL ONLY (hidden desktop).
# From lx1 (build/agent3/runs/20261122-195210-lx1-devoff4) and lx2 (...-201420-lx2-devoff4):
#   - START at the title does nothing; the A after it opens the front end (220/528, C8 all white, tags placed);
#   - ~8 A presses (~50 s) later the story starts: INSTALL0 probes, profile read, amber fade 99 42 0E (lx2 115 s);
#   - loading, then heavy 3D (1000-13000 draws, up to 1.5M vertices, 10-35 fps) for ~110-155 s, working set
#     ~720 MB -> ~1300 MB: the level load (lx2 ~190-300 s, lx1 ~214-370 s);
#   - then 766/110956 at ~60 fps with the pads cycling a 6-colour rainbow (first orange FF 6E 00 = mark vortex);
#     no input changed it in lx2 except START (787/111292), then A (785/123950); B and a tag re-place did not.
# The route ends itself with 'stop' ~95 s after the vortex mark (run-game closes the game then), so -Seconds is
# only a cap (600). Typical length 430-500 s.
wait_first_frame 240
mark first-frame
sleep 50
mark title
press START
sleep 3
press A                                         # title -> front end (C8 all white); tags 2 s later
wait_log "Toypad: pad 3 mode 1 lit FF FF FF" 25
mark pads-white
wait_log "Toypad listener: LOAD -> pad=3" 20
mark tags-placed
sleep 3
press A
sleep 5
mark m01
press A
sleep 5
mark m02
press A
sleep 5
mark m03

press A
sleep 5
mark m09
press A
sleep 5
mark m10

mark story-load
press A
